exclusions.source_text: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) \< 2.5x ULN
Left ventricular ejection fraction \> institutional lower limit of normal by MUGA scan or echocardiogram within 30 days of first protocol treatment
exclusions.threshold: LVEF > institutional lower limit of normal

exclusions.source_text: Patients with known active advanced malignant solid tumors are excluded (except for basal or squamous skin cancers, or carcinomas in situ). Patients with additional hematologic malignancies that require treatment are excluded.
Known positive status for HIV infection; known active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection

Clinically significant cardiopulmonary disease including uncontrolled or NYHA class 3 or 4 congestive heart failure, uncontrolled angina, uncontrolled hypertension, uncontrolled arrhythmia, myocardial infarction or stroke within 6 months of first protocol treatment, or QTc \> 480 ms
exclusions.threshold: NYHA class 3 or 4; QTc > 480 ms; MI within 6 months

exclusions.source_text: Pregnant women are excluded from this study
Active CNS involvement by AML or BPDCN.
Age \>= 18 years with relapsed or refractory AML
